transcript: What? Surprise! It's Thanksgiving! We weren't supposed to have a Thanksgiving this year. Well, we are having one. Is this why you didn't let me get food? Yeah! You guys did this? And it's all your favorites. You have a lot of favorites. It's everything that I love. Yeah. All of it. Excited I mean you spent like nine months pushing out a baby. So the least we could do for this new one is you know Fiji sweetie Thank you You're welcome What is that? Is that the excited dance? I wait all year for this Mmm Green bean casserole? Is it good? Yeah? All year just for that? all of it but especially the green casserole do you really still need the puppy pads
metadata_caption: The puppy pad at the end! 🙈😂 backstory ::: Kay LOVES the holidays. She especially loves the different types of foods! She talks about the different casseroles and dishes throughout the year and gets so happy when she finally eats them during the holidays. ❤️ This year was going to be different for us… Since Ellie was due during Thanksgiving, we knew that we wouldn’t be able to go see family, and we would have our hands too full with bean to be able to cook thanksgiving foods for ourselves. Kay was sad, but she had come to terms with the fact that she wouldn’t get to celebrate with family this year. 😔 Well! My family and I cooked up a little plan; While Kay and I were gone to bean’s first doctors appointment, my family ran to the store and got the stuff to cook up all of Kay’s favorite thanksgiving dishes. I stalled Kay for a while after the appointment by having us stop so she could feed Ellie! 😂 When my family gave me the ok, we drove home! On the way back, Kay asked if we could stop and get fast food, and I panicked a little, but said that I would get her food once we got home! 😂 When we arrived, the plan worked perfectly and she had no idea! I’m so glad that she was able to have her favorite holiday foods this year. I’m also so thankful that my family wanted to help make her day! She deserves it after all that she went through to have our precious baby bean! ❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant
